items.html:
The comic you are thinking of is titled "
Deal with the Devil" by Nicholas Gurewitch of The Perry Bible Fellowship.
In this classic strip, a man successfully completes a dark ritual to summon a demon. However, instead of demanding soul-binding contracts, performing malevolent acts, or wreaking havoc, the massive, red demon immediately makes himself completely at home. He sits comfortably on the couch, hoards the man's snacks, dominates the remote to watch television, and effectively turns into the ultimate, lazy roommate.
You can read the original comic directly on the official website via the
Deal with the Devil comic page.
